paragraphs.text: Azlask , also known as The Swelling Scourge , is a legendary Eldrazi that was introduced in Modern Horizons 3 Commander .
Azlask is an Eldrazi that appears as an amalgamation of white, red, and blue tendrils that form its body. Its exact origin or history is not known, other than that it is a member of Ulamog 's brood.

Azlask gives experience counters to the player anytime it or a colorless creature dies and has an activated ability that increases the power/toughness of creatures for the turn based on the number of experience counters. The ability also boosts Spawns and Scions to become terrible indestructible annihilators .
